_comment: THE CONTROL for edf_blink_loop_cashes_drain.json: byte-for-byte the same board and the same
assembled Emiel/Peregrine Drake loop, with Shivan Gorge ({2}{R}, {T}: 1 damage to each
opponent) as the sink instead of Essence Depleter.
The Gorge needs a fresh UNTAP per activation, so it rides the loop's iteration count and is
fired by SpendSurplusOnDamageSinks at the TOP of each iteration -- before the tap-ahead, which
would otherwise take the tap its ability needs. That route already worked, which is exactly
what made the pair decisive when the drain route did not: same loop, same go-off count, one
sink cashed and the other not.
So this fixture's job is to stay green while the drain side is worked on. A change to the
loop's reservation or spend order that fixes the drain and breaks this has traded one dead
